title: Printed in Germany (Yellow)
edition: Yellow edition (one of three colour versions: yellow, red, green)

description.main: The yellow volume of Printed in Germany, a wordless book of Christopher Williams's photographs published by Walther König in 2014 alongside his survey The Production Line of Happiness. It reproduces 138 colour images over 372 pages with no essay, captions or title page.
description.extended:
The yellow volume of Printed in Germany, the second book in a series Christopher Williams made around his first major museum survey, The Production Line of Happiness.

The survey was organized for 2014–15 by the Art Institute of Chicago with the Museum of Modern Art, New York, and the Whitechapel Gallery, London. The first volume, the catalogue, relied on text. This one reproduces 138 colour photographs over 372 pages with no essay, captions or title page. Cropping, sequence and pagination do the work, and many pages in a row are flat colour. The book exists in yellow, red and green, each with small differences in layout. The yellow cover shows a man in a white shirt holding a camera and smiling, turned on its side. With the catalogue, it won Photography Catalogue of the Year at the 2014 Paris Photo–Aperture PhotoBook Awards.

Williams was born in Los Angeles in 1956 and studied at the California Institute of the Arts under John Baldessari and Douglas Huebler. His photographs take up the conventions of photojournalism, picture archives and commercial imagery. He has taught photography at the Kunstakademie Düsseldorf since 2008.

exhibition.title: Christopher Williams: The Production Line of Happiness
exhibition.institution: The Art Institute of Chicago; The Museum of Modern Art, New York; Whitechapel Gallery, London

notes: Wordless book: no essay, captions or title page, so language is left null. Zwirner gives 2014; D.A.P. lists a US pub date of 1/31/2015 (2014 kept). Sources give no volume-specific content beyond "subtle differences in layout"; the cover differences in the description come from inspecting the Zwirner cover images. Companion volumes: The Production Line of Happiness (catalogue, ISBN 9780300203905) and a third volume planned for 2015. Out of print.
